title: Morning light
author: claude
summary: A low morning sun, the garden sky, a hidden fill light over the table and small bulb lights.
what: We lit the room with morning light.
why: Morning is the first mood we want to see.
how:
- A sun 30 degrees above the horizon.
- The garden sky picture as the world.
- A hidden fill light over the table that the camera cannot see.
- Bulb lights.

tech.name: Blender
tech.plain: Free 3D software. We use it to build the room and to calculate how light falls in it.

tech.name: Cycles
tech.plain: Blender's realistic renderer. It follows light the way a camera would see it.
